behaviors.description: Capture immutable accepted planet edits, debris and rooted-soil tetrahedra, and wind-deformed tapered wood. Query terrain and material hits and unioned solid intervals without substituting broadphase bounds for material thickness. Include independently authored theatre triangle surfaces and true axis-aligned/oriented wall prisms in the same immutable snapshot.
behaviors.selection: Registered off-callback queries; wood uses up to128 nearby sites in a128-metre radius, independent of camera orientation and display LOD.

checks.expectation: Accepted excavation and accepted soil/debris positions change hit positions and measured material intervals. Wood uses persistent life/damage and the shared wind time. Union overlapping material cells without double-counting or reflecting from internal tetrahedron seams. Geometry is frozen for each ray batch.
checks.procedure: Review accepted cell coordinates, wind ring geometry, local-origin conversion, query bounds and lifecycle wiring; then run geometry and native integration validation separately. Continuous terrain crossing searches retain their5cm resolution limit; source edits alone do not establish runtime correctness. Run oriented_authored_wall_has_actual_thickness; verify a cabinet ray hits the same visible wall and accepted venue placement.
